text_nodes.text: The panel's own sentence says children go through continuous physiologic and anatomic changes, which is why a model fitted to adults is not the model a child needs.
The panel named where the gap is.

Artificial intelligence (AI) applications have transformed radiology, yet pediatric medical imaging remains substantially underrepresented in AI development, validation, regulation, and implementation.

It did worse on the patients it had never seen.

It scored 0.615 on the brain metastasis cohort it was built on and 0.574 on the cohort it had not met. The paper's own intervals are 0.543 to 0.687 and 0.491 to 0.658, and its authors ask for cautious use.

A parent can ask at the desk what population each imaging tool was validated on. The Food and Drug Administration's device list carries the word pediatric in two device names and nowhere in its own text. The panel wants pediatric infrastructure, not adult tools reused.
